learning_outcomes.text: Apply an engineering process to the production of software

Apply principles of software engineering such as software requirements analysis, software analysis and design, implementation, testing, code inspection, configuration management, build, delivery and deployment
Software product quality assessment and improvement

assessment_methods.method: Individual oral exam (for final grades above 16 points)

assessment_rules: To pass, both the set of 6 practical scripts and the set of 2 tests must have a minimum grade of half the maximum score (3 points for scripts, 7 points for tests). Final grades above 16 points will be confirmed in an individual oral exam. For the second assessment period, students can choose to retake material from the first test (35%), second test (35%), or the entire course (70%), with the remaining 30% from the semester assignments. The special assessment period follows the same scheme as the second assessment period.
